notes: DUPLICATE of I182197443412 (Magnus Månsson Rånge, 1744-1822, m. Britta Gabrielsdotter). Same birth/death and same Hadäng, Velinge farmstead. Kept for the cause-of-death note on his father Måns Månsson Rånge (I182195861510, 'Dog av huvudsjuka' = died of apoplexy/stroke) and its children list, which matches the primary's documented son Johannes Magnusson (I182197443344 = this record's I182195860775, identical birth date/place) plus three additional siblings. This whole branch cascades into further downstream duplicate-person flags already tracked separately (Johannes Magnusson unlabeled duplicate; Gustaf Rånge I182197443234/I182195860718; Anna Josefina Rånge I182195860382 vs. Anna Josephina Svenson I182197442975). See docs/research/ancestors/gen08-britta-gabrielsdotter-magnus-mansson-range.md.
